assumptions: Q1 default: Assume drops from desk height (~0.5 m) onto hard floor without functional damage.

assumptions: Q1 default: Assume standard UV stabilizers are sufficient for typical outdoor use, with no specific accelerated weathering test requirement.

assumptions: Q1 default: No IP rating required (indoor use only).

Q3 default: Natural recycled ABS with visible speckles, no added colorants.

intent.summary: Retail-channel air quality detector for rental apartments. Lowest possible unit cost is the top priority: target CNY 12 per housing at 10k units/year. Plain but tidy look in a colour that hides scuffs and fingerprints. It must survive knocks on a desk. Two-part shell, no decoration beyond a printed logo, budget tooling.

conflicts.description: Target unit cost of CNY 12 may be difficult to achieve with ABS or rABS at 10k units/year, especially with budget tooling and a two-part shell requiring assembly. Material and moulding costs alone could approach or exceed this target.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Consider simplifying design (e.g., snap-fit without screws, thinner walls), using rABS if cheaper, or negotiating with suppliers; if not feasible, raise target cost to CNY 15-18.

intent.summary: Flagship portable air-quality detector housing with premium soft-touch painted finish, IP67 waterproof, ultra-slim 18 mm profile, 100% recycled plastic, under 120 g, and housing cost ≤ CNY 9, launching in six weeks.

conflicts.description: IP67 waterproofing with an ultra-slim 18 mm profile and soft-touch painted finish is extremely difficult to achieve reliably in injection moulded rABS within a six-week launch and CNY 9 cost target.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Relax IP67 to IP54 or increase thickness/cost; use overmoulded gaskets and ultrasonic welding, but this likely exceeds cost and timeline.

conflicts.description: Achieving a housing cost ≤ CNY 9 with 100% recycled plastic, premium soft-touch paint, IP67 sealing, and a six-week launch is economically infeasible at 10,000 units/year.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Increase budget to at least CNY 18, use virgin ABS/PC-ABS, or reduce finish/IP rating requirements.

conflicts.description: Total product mass under 120 g with internals weighing ~92 g leaves only 28 g for the housing, which is very challenging for an IP67 sealed enclosure with soft-touch paint and 18 mm thickness.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Increase mass limit to at least 140 g or reduce internal weight; consider thinner walls and lighter sealing methods, but IP67 may be compromised.

open_questions.question: What is the exact environmental exposure? IP67 suggests full immersion, but portable air-quality detectors are often used indoors or in light outdoor conditions.
open_questions.default_assumption: Mixed indoor/outdoor use with occasional water exposure, but not continuous immersion.

open_questions.question: Is the soft-touch painted finish required on all surfaces, including sealing areas? Paint can interfere with gasket adhesion and ultrasonic welding.
open_questions.default_assumption: Paint is applied only to visible exterior surfaces, with masked sealing and joining areas.

open_questions.question: What is the acceptable trade-off if all constraints cannot be met? For example, is cost or IP rating more critical?
open_questions.default_assumption: Cost is the highest priority, followed by IP rating, then finish and sustainability.

open_questions.question: Is the six-week launch for tooling and production validation, or just for design freeze? Tooling for IP67 with complex sealing typically takes longer.
open_questions.default_assumption: Six weeks is for design freeze; tooling and production will follow later.
